areas_investigacion: Relations between China and Latin America
perfil_profesional: Full Professor at the Faculty of International, Political and Urban Studies. PhD in Development Studies (London School of Economics), Master in International Affairs (Johns Hopkins University) and Diplom in Political Science (University of Potsdam, Germany). Director of Postgraduate Studies (2016-2019) and editor of the journal Desafíos (2013-2018). Fields of interest : International political economy, especially international finance, International Monetary Fund and World Bank, political and economic relations between China and Latin America
formacion_academica: 1999, Magíster en Relaciones Internacionales, Johns Hopkins University
2010, PhD en Estudios de Desarrollo y Ciencia Política, The London School of Economics And Political Science, University of London
